description: Our team aims to draft a project that integrates the best technologies available today to help astronauts, cosmonauts, and space agencies render real-time data, assess the current situation, and receive alerts about any type of combustion occurring in the microgravity of the Milky Way. With the help of AI, data analysis, and data representation skills, we bring a platform where NASA datasets are seamlessly represented.
summary:
Flame in Freefall is a question often neglected by students and professionals in the field. This is why our team decided that this project, which focuses on solving the challenges of flame in freefall, would be the best way to showcase our abilities to break down problems and innovate further solutions. Our project, Firecracker/g, signifies a flame under microgravity.

In our project, we combine AI's representational capabilities with its fundamental application: machine learning. Firecracker/g uses NASA's certified data to create 3D models, animated videos, and AI-powered summaries and statistics. This data can be used by current and aspiring professionals in the field of space exploration, eliminating the need for researchers to manually search through dozens of NASA datasets. This allows them to improve the safety of human space exploration. With the in-depth knowledge of flames in microgravity provided by our model, we aim to pave the way for the safest possible exploration of space.
details:
Introduction to the Problem

Our project is aimed at providing a better understanding of the characteristics of a flame under microgravity. We will give you a visual simulation by replicating the exact environment and deliver a scientific analysis and explanation on the topic. Moreover, the website uses the dataset and information provided by NASA’s experts.

How it works

Working solely based on factual data provided by NASA, our model provides the most accurate and summarised information about the topic at hand. Firecracker/g is a combination of 3 major tools: 3D model simulation, animated videos, and AI-powered summaries and statistics. These work in the following manner

1.) 3D Model Simulation

Our 3D Model Simulation uses a 3D grid space, like modeling software, to provide a visual representation of flame in microgravity under different ceteris paribus conditions. These factors can be adjusted using specific sliders or by entering the specific values for the conditions giving an accurate representation of the users’ needs. This can help professionals test conditions of possible safety hazards in a microgravity environment.

2.) Animated Videos

The animated video tool provides a summary for the topic at hand for non-professional and gives them an insight on the topic. Equipped with pre-installed prompts for summary generation, this tool uses both visual and audio representation to give users a variable-time explanation on their input regarding the topic. It is highly responsive to various types of details regarding the topic and can be viewed in different voices and languages making it accessible to a larger number of users.

3.) AI-Powered Summaries & Statistics

Even though this is the most common tool, it is the most efficient and fruitful for professionals in this field. Using past NASA data and machine-learning capabilities this tool enables pioneering professionals and boosts further research amongst current professionals on this problem.

Benefits & Impact

Being one of lesser known yet major concerns in space exploration, flames in microgravity require to be understood by a larger community. Within the non-professional community, this model allows summarised information learning through short-form content while for professionals, this model advances the path for extensive research with access to a foundation.

Technologies Used

This model was published using the help of exhaustive NASA datasets and SI-powered tools. This was built with major help from Google’s AI services, which allowed us to program in an IDE using agents, extensions, and plug-ins that helped debug and code the website. We also used Netlify to launch our website on a free domain (for now).

Innovation

We believe our biggest innovation in this model is 2 of the 3 tools we have integrated and built into the website. The first one is the video generation tool, which allows a wider audience to understand and learn about this topic. Secondly, the 3D model simulation tool allows exact conditions to be tested and represented in a visual environment.

Our target is to be different an innovative and make sure all types audiences can access and understand our model.
